question: What adverse consequences follow from using burnt or improperly supported offerings?
premises: A burnt elephant-foot item leads to servitude.
This consequence arises when it is given.
It also arises when rested on a limb.
inference: Using a burnt or improperly supported item brings the consequence of servitude.
uncertainties: The precise referent of ādvipad is unclear from the verse alone.
plain_english: If something burnt, like an elephant-foot item, is given or rested on a limb, servitude results.
